notes.freshness: Live provider snapshots, with supplied timestamps and season labels. Historical schedules/matches reflect final state, not prediction-time availability.
notes.known_stale_coach_fields: Roster endpoint includes stale legacy coach entries (e.g. Arsene Wenger for Arsenal). Raw field retained; coaches must not be used as current coaching data.
notes.units: Player height is ESPN inches; weight is pounds. Provider display units are also retained.
notes.injury_coverage: Only supplied roster injury arrays, not an authoritative injury registry. Empty reports are unknown coverage, not confirmation all fit.
notes.odds_limitation: ESPN retrospective/current snapshots lack full exchange/order-book and time history; not usable as contemporaneous arbitrage proof.
notes.membership_scope: Curated team/player rows only current 2026-27 clubs; excluded clubs may appear as opponents/raw payload context.
